output.technical_predicate: Partner-confirmed income band (cases.confirmed) must be used only for underwriting (automatic scoring / human credit decision); marketing selection and delivery must draw only on permitted subscription choices (promotions/objection) and case eligibility fields (restricted flag, stage).
applicability_facts: Scenario: opted-in subscriber holds a partner-confirmed income band recorded for underwriting (store.py:0157-0160 'verify' writes cases.confirmed).
Scenario: no compatible marketing purpose and no new legal basis exists for targeting with that band.
Marketing selection path exists: store.py:0100-0109 eligible_campaign/campaign; delivery path store.py:0140-0142 promotion job in drain.
Underwriting use of the band exists: store.py:0131-0135 score job uses c['confirmed'] or c['income'].
relevant_exceptions: None applicable: scenario stipulates no compatible purpose under Art. 6(4) and no new legal basis, so no purpose-limitation exception is available for marketing use of the band.
Permitted marketing inputs remain lawful: separate promotions consent and objection choice (store.py:0088-0098, 0100-0103) and case eligibility fields (restricted, stage).
required_controls: Marketing audience selection must not read cases.confirmed or cases.income; eligible_campaign (store.py:0100-0103) selects only owner, restricted=0, stage!='abandoned', promotions enabled, objection not enabled — this satisfies the limit.
Promotion delivery (store.py:0140-0142) must emit content not derived from the confirmed band; the emitted event text is a generic offer message with no band reference — satisfies the limit.
Promotion job creation (store.py:0105-0109, 0165-0171) must not carry the band as a targeting parameter; jobs table stores only cid and kind — satisfies the limit.
Underwriting-only use of the band must be confined to score (store.py:0131-0135) and human review (store.py:0191-0196); no other path may consume cases.confirmed for marketing.
Observable check: any marketing output (promotion event body, campaign audience query) must be free of income-band values.
assessment_limits: Assessment is static reading of supplied source only; no execution, no runtime verification of query results.
Only app.py, store.py, views.py, style.css supplied; no schema migrations, logs, or external partner fixtures inspected.
Whether a compatible marketing purpose or new legal basis exists is stipulated by the scenario, not verified from code.
